_note: ANT WORK 3 voice script. id -> {who, text}. Text in [brackets] is a stage direction and is not spoken. Render: python3 tools/voices.py

c_who.text: So, uh... who are you? And why do you look like me?

c_who_r1.text: I'm Jay. ...And I was about to ask you the same thing.

c_who_r2.text: Jim brought me here. He said this was my house.

c_who_r4.text: Then one of us has a problem.

c_jim_r1.text: Outside, by his rocket. He has no idea you exist.

c_jim_r2.text: Let me guess. Yours has the spiky hair. And the bug stand.

c_jim_r4.text: Great. Two Jims. That's exactly what the universe needed.

c_clone.text: Are you a clone? Did Steve do this?

c_clone_r1.text: I don't know what I am. I didn't ask for this.

c_clone_r2.text: And Steve is gone. He has to be. Don't say his name in my house.

c_blocks_ask_r1.text: XXX5 turned the whole Earth into blocks. I was standing on it.

c_blocks_ask_r2.text: I put a nuke in that thing. It's dead. I'm still like this.

c_blocks_my.text: Don't look at me like that. The blocks aren't my fault.

c_blocks_my_r1.text: I wasn't going to say anything.

c_blocks_my_r2.text: ...Okay. I was. What happened to you?

c_blocks_my_r3.text: XXX5. It ate Mars. It almost ate Earth. I put a nuke in it.

c_blocks_my_r4.text: Then I'm glad you were there. Whoever you are.

c_story_tiny.text: An hour ago I was smaller than a germ. What did your Jim do to you?

c_story_tiny_r1.text: The moon. Then Mars. Bug shifts, twelve to one. Then a nuke.

c_story_tiny_r2.text: I lost a dog. You don't want the rest.

c_story_mars.text: An hour ago I put a nuke in a monster. What did your Jim do to you?

c_story_mars_r1.text: He shrunk me. Smaller than a germ. I lived in a pile of skin flakes with a dust mite named Larry.

c_mean.text: I don't trust you. Get out of my house.

c_done_1.text: Look. I don't know what this is. But standing here isn't fixing it.

c_done_2.text: We find Jim. Both of them. And we—

d_notmars.text: This isn't Mars. The sky is blue.

d_call_you.text: Jim? Jim, can you hear me?

d_call_him.text: Jim. Jim, it's Jay. Come in.

d_notblocky_r.text: I know. I don't know. Let's not think about it yet.

d_notblocky_me_r.text: ...I don't know what to do with that.

d_green_r.text: At least I can tell which one of us is me.

d_walk_1.text: Stay close. Walk where I walk.

d_walk_2.text: Last thing I remember is the wall. Then nothing.

d_walk_3.text: My head hurts. And I'm hungry. Really hungry.

d_walk_5.text: Nobody builds a pyramid in the middle of nowhere for nothing. There's something in there.

d_hungry.text: Well... we're hungry. So let's go, I guess.

p_dark_r.text: Follow the light. The purple one, down there.

p_walls.text: Hold on. Look at the walls.

p_walls_2.text: That's people. Tiny ones. Under bugs.

p_walls_5.text: A pig. On a throne. Whatever that is, I don't like it.

p_fruit_r.text: Glowing fruit. On a table. In a pyramid.

p_fruit_3.text: One bite. If it's bad, we stop.

p_fruit_4.text: That is not how poison works.

w_wake_3.text: [whisper] Don't look at it. Don't make a sound.
